title: Communal learnings ledger
description: Append-only communal ledger of prior-attempt learnings anchored to functions, files, and areas. All statuses are indexed — corroborated, proposed, and refuted (known dead ends) — each chunk labeled with status and confidence so agents weigh entries instead of trusting them blindly.

provenance.origin: learnings appended by librarian/worker agents, boundary sync, and human extraction from run evidence and Discord mining
provenance.authority: communal prior-attempt knowledge — corroborated high-confidence entries outrank proposed ones, refuted entries mark known dead ends; all outranked by an actual objdiff result on the target function
